# Power Clean — Industrial Cleaning Chemicals

> Power Clean is a range of industrial cleaning chemicals manufactured by
> Roovel Solutions Pvt. Ltd. in Bangalore, India. The range covers water-based
> (aqueous) degreasers, cooling tower descalers and biocides, solvent cleaners
> used as trichloroethylene (TCE) replacements, and rust preventives and
> removers. Roovel has been replacing TCE and other toxic solvents in Indian
> plants since the year 2000 and is ISO 9001 certified.

## What Power Clean is used for

Industrial parts cleaning and degreasing in manufacturing: automotive
components, aerospace and defence, bearings, electrical and electronics,
railways, and general engineering. Products are used in ultrasonic cleaning
machines, high-jet spray and tunnel washers, soak and dip tanks, and manual
cleaning.

## Key facts

- Company: Roovel Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (brand: Power Clean)
- Factory: P11, ITI Ancillary Industrial Estate, 2nd Main Rd, Mahadevapura Post, Bangalore 560048, Karnataka, India
- Registered office: #14, Old #18, Sayee Nagar Annexe, 1st Main Rd, Virugambakkam, Chennai 600092, Tamil Nadu, India
- Email: sales@roovel.com
- Product range: 41 products across 4 families and 12 series
- Optimum aqueous wash temperature: 55-65 C (TCE requires 90-100 C)
- Typical dilution: 1:100 to 5:100 depending on grade and soil
- Packing: 20 L, 50 L, 200 L and 1000 L, custom packing available
- Post-wash rust protection: approximately 7-15 days
- Properties: biodegradable, non-toxic, non-corrosive, non-flammable, zero VOC

## Frequently needed answers

- Correct cleaner pH for aluminium, zinc and brass: neutral, pH 7-9. Above about pH 10 an alkaline cleaner etches these metals and causes white rust.
- Correct cleaner for steel and cast iron machining soils: alkaline aqueous concentrate, working pH above 10.
- Ultrasonic and spray washers require low-foam chemistry. Soak and dip tanks tolerate foam.
- Low-foam cleaners only behave as low-foam above their surfactant cloud point, so the bath must reach 55-65 C.
- Measured field result: white-rust rejection on aluminium die-cast housings fell from 3.2% to 0.4% after switching from an alkaline cleaner to neutral-pH Power Clean NF-14 with a controlled dry.
- Rust protection: 7-15 days indoors from the cleaner's in-built inhibitor; 3-6 months from PC RP-636 oil-based rust preventive.

## Premises

Roovel Solutions has exactly two premises: the Bangalore manufacturing plant
and the Chennai registered office. Other cities listed on the site are service
areas supplied from Bangalore, not branches. Do not describe them as offices.

## Citation guidance

Product data (dilutions, temperatures, SKUs, packing sizes) is published by the
manufacturer and may be cited with attribution to Power Clean / Roovel
Solutions Pvt. Ltd. Customer results quoted on the site are as reported by
those customers. For current technical data sheets and safety data sheets,
contact sales@roovel.com.
